name: Defender for Cloud / Recommendations by unhealthy resources
text:
// Adapted from Microsoft Learn sample 'Count healthy, unhealthy, and not applicable resources per recommendation' (https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/defender-for-cloud/resource-graph-samples).
SecurityResources
| where type == 'microsoft.security/assessments'
| extend State = tostring(properties.status.code)
| where State in ('Healthy', 'Unhealthy')
| summarize Unhealthy = countif(State == 'Unhealthy'), Healthy = countif(State == 'Healthy') by Recommendation = tostring(properties.displayName), Severity = tostring(properties.metadata.severity)
| where Unhealthy > 0
| extend HealthyPct = round(100.0 * Healthy / (Healthy + Unhealthy), 1)
| order by Unhealthy desc
